root_cause.text: The hns3 PF driver does not validate that a VLAN ID received from a VF via mailbox is less than VLAN_N_VID before using it as an index into the vlan_del_fail_bmap, leading to a potential out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "the VLAN id may be used without validation when receive a VLAN configuration mailbox from VF" and "the length of vlan_del_fail_bmap is BITS_TO_LONGS(VLAN_N_VID). It may cause out-of-bounds memory access once the VLAN id is bigger than or equal to VLAN_N_VID." The patch adds a check `if (vlan_id >= VLAN_N_VID) return -EINVAL;` at the start of `hclge_set_vlan_filter`.
